text:
sam: quick repro: Vite (worker target) + webpack parts. import SDK as `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js'` -> worker preview throws `ReferenceError: require is not defined`.

anya: did you check package.json exports/main/module/browser? bundlers pick different fields.

sam: package.json uses `exports` with import->dist/index.esm.js and require->dist/index.cjs.js. but the CJS build has top-level require calls. sometimes the build chooses require side for worker bundles.

lee: short consumer workarounds we've collected: 1) vite dev: `optimizeDeps.include = ['redwood-inference-js']` 2) vite SSR/preview: `ssr.noExternal = ['redwood-inference-js']` 3) webpack: `resolve.mainFields = ['browser','module','main']`.

anya: SDK fixes we should prioritize: publish an unambiguous ESM browser entry (add `browser` + `exports."./browser"`), avoid any top-level `require` in files reachable by import condition, and ship an explicit `dist/edge.mjs` shim mapped at `exports."./edge"`.

sam: also saw default-import shape issues: some bundlers end up with `Redwood.default === undefined`. publishing ESM with an actual `export default` and also named exports fixes a lot.

lee: build-side note: rollup plugin order matters. ensure node-resolve runs before commonjs so ESM stays ESM. lint `dist/*.mjs` for `require\(`/`module\.` and fail publish if found.

build-bot: nightly/sdk-pack: failed matrix worker/vite -> runtime `require is not defined` (logs attached).

anya: short-term consumer unblock: import direct ESM path `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js/dist/index.esm.js'` or `import 'redwood-inference-js/edge'` if we publish the shim. long-term: CI pack-and-smoke test across vite/rollup/webpack worker templates.

sam: filing SDK issue with repro + configs. will add the tiny shim patch as a stopgap and help validate CI matrix. :rocket:
